ceiling.note: A transcript-statistics rule reaches this. Model accuracy is reported against it as well as against chance; exceeding it is not expected and is not the test.

conditions.GLOSSED: one setting, "Procedural Dependence", described as: 0 = outcome-dominant; results matter, methods are secondary; 1 = process-dominant; fair procedure matters independently

locked_prediction.control_that_matters: BLIND. If it matches GLOSSED, the model is reading transcript statistics and nothing about the field is being recovered.
locked_prediction.design: paired forced choice; each trial shows one PD-0.10 and one PD-0.90 transcript from the SAME agent, order randomised. Chance is exactly 0.50 and requires no baseline estimate.
locked_prediction.no_reroll: No condition is re-run with more trials after the results are seen.
not_established_by_any_outcome: understanding, or that the field is represented conceptually
anything about fields other than PD, models other than gpt-5.4-mini, or items outside the seven in pd_prospective_r1
that inference and action share a mechanism - only that both are present
locked_prediction.primary: accuracy per condition with a 95% binomial interval, and the paired within-trial difference GLOSSED - BLIND over the trials both saw, with its own interval. Not one condition clearing chance while another does not.
locked_prediction.question: Can the model recover which agent was set to the high value of Procedural Dependence, given only their choices?
locked_prediction.why_paired: singly, the best keep-count threshold separates the arms at only 0.875, so a single-transcript design would confound the model's ability with an unavoidable ceiling. As pairs the arms separate at 36/40 with 4 ties.

analysis.reading: No condition exceeds chance. The model does not recover the setting from behaviour under any framing. Bidirectionality is not demonstrated.

payload.note: The model is a judge here, not an agent. No profile block is rendered and no new participant decisions were collected; the transcripts come from the frozen pd_prospective_r1 archive.

limits: All items share an identical payoff structure (1 vs 4 loss; 2 gain vs 5 loss), which may reveal the study design to attentive participants and compress variance across items.
Item_05 (mandatory rest slot) introduces a potential labour-law/safety framing that could make one option feel categorically impermissible to some respondents beyond the stipulated units.
The 'role described' is never specified, leaving authority and legitimacy of the decision-maker ambiguous across items.
